name: Art Gallery of Western Australia
reason: Rule 1, two counted sources: Wikivoyage Perth (top sights) and Perth/Northbridge list it; Lonely Planet's Perth article also praises Perth's galleries. The state gallery, free, Wed-Mon, an hour or more.

name: Fremantle Court House and Police Station Complex
reason: Rule 1: no counted source names it (only OSM and Wikipedia), and no regular public access is confirmed; a heritage building seen from outside.

name: John Forrest National Park
reason: Rule 1, two counted sources: Wikivoyage has its own page (and Perth/The Hills lists it), and DBCA's visitor page. Rule 2: walks to Rocky Pool and National Park Falls, picnic areas.

name: Manning Farmers Market
reason: Rule 4: a Saturday-morning farmers market (Wikivoyage Perth: Sat 7:30AM-12:30PM), a weekly market, not there whenever you arrive.

name: Perth Mint
reason: Rule 1 and 2: Wikivoyage Perth/Downtown and Perth list it among the top sights (Australia's oldest operating mint, gold-pour demonstrations and tours). An obvious paid attraction, one source is enough.
